neighbours.label: ' about' as a spatial particle after verbs of motion, scattering or idling (ran about, scattered about, lounged about), also 'about ready'; 'about' meaning 'concerning' is quiet. ' around' in the same slot also fires
fire: Chickens wandered about the yard pecking at the dirt.
Broken glass lay scattered about the kitchen floor.
The boys rushed about the house looking for their shoes.
He spent the summer lounging about in his dressing gown.
Servants bustled about the hall carrying trays.
The puppy rolled about on the carpet.
Tourists milled about the square waiting for the guide.
Leaves were blowing about the empty playground.
quiet: Farmers complained about the yard's poor drainage.
She wrote a long essay about the kitchen fire.
The boys argued about whose shoes were faster.
He spent the summer reading about ancient Rome.
Servants gossiped about the new housekeeper.
The vet asked about the puppy's diet.
Tourists asked the guide about the old square.
The teacher spoke about safety on the playground.

notes: Probes: ran / scattered / wandered / strewn about 0.35-0.68, 'about ready' 0.60, 'ran around' 0.48; told me about, is about, talked about, worried about under 0.01; about fifty 0.15, about to rain 0.08.
